create_ChannelStore: create a ChannelStore instance that persists IM chat-to-DeerFlow thread mappings in a JSON file
build_set_thread_id: build a ChannelStore mapping that associates an IM conversation with a DeerFlow thread ID
test_get_thread_id: test the ChannelStore.get_thread_id method to look up a DeerFlow thread by channel and chat ID
refactor_remove: refactor the ChannelStore.remove method to delete one or all mappings for a given channel and chat ID
review_list_entries: review the ChannelStore.list_entries method to list all stored mappings optionally filtered by channel name
